requiredFindings.title: Workspace integrity checks member identities but not their pinned mounts or overlay record
requiredFindings.finding: The tool never compares workspace-overlay.json with the archived/manifest overlay. It hashes the observed bytes into the output, while mount validation compares only the multiset of member IDs. Renaming a member symlink to node_modules retains that multiset but places the verified member below a pruned anchor in compose, changing the modeled population and potentially manufacturing a passing workspace margin. overlay_root_tree also scans its root without first refusing a symlink root.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Verify the overlay record against its pinned archived bytes or canonical manifest overlay and validate the exact mount-to-entry/digest mapping, not just memberIds. Refuse unexpected mounts and reject a symlink/non-directory overlay root before traversal. Preserve the no-follow and lead-readable-only guarantees, centralizing digest joins through the guarded helper. Add controls for a renamed/swapped mount, altered overlay record and symlink overlay root.

requiredFindings.title: Gitlink placeholders bypass the store directory-mode check
requiredFindings.finding: Ordinary directories pass through visit and must be 0555. A gitlink placeholder takes a separate branch that checks only that it is an empty directory. A writable placeholder therefore retains the same computed gitTree and QD-22 digest and is admitted despite the required 0555 mode. The model assumes passing custody rather than observing that changed mode.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Require STORE_DIR_MODE on each gitlink placeholder before listing it, along with the existing no-symlink/empty checks. Add independent synthetic gitlink pins and controls showing a valid empty 0555 placeholder passes and writable, nonempty or symlink placeholders refuse.

requiredFindings.title: The walk-vector soundness control can accept a partially executed walk
requiredFindings.finding: charged returns completion status and ledger usage, but the 52-vector test discards completion and checks only used <= predicted. A budget refusal or instrument/host failure can stop early with a small used value and satisfy the inequality without measuring the planned walk. The composed-workspace test correctly checks completed; the ordinary-vector test does not. Typed discovery refusals are Ok results and need not be treated as incomplete.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Require successful completion of discover_downward for these synthetic vectors before accepting the usage comparison, or explicitly match any independently expected infrastructure errors. Add a control demonstrating that an aborted native measurement cannot pass as a soundness result.

nonBlockingObservations.location: SCOPE.md: The model is tight, not just safe
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The supplied log has 46 exact object-and-edge matches out of 56, rather than 45. Over-counting also includes the successful nested-gitdir-file-repository case (440 actual edges versus 475 predicted) and post-capture ACL cases, not only custody refusal before capture. Keep the general claim as an upper bound: three large native store matches support those individual cases, not exactness for all T2 entries. Correct the tightness description when publishing the revised scope.
